apps.name: FlekDeck
apps.subtitle: Run your apps inside FlekDeck
apps.localizedDescription:
If you used LiveContainer, then to save progress in applications/games, put FlecDeck on top (do not delete LiveContainer).

Run your apps inside FlekDeck — a powerful app environment designed to feel like a second operating system.

FlekDeck brings a familiar Home Screen, built-in multitasking, fast app switching, a dedicated Installer, and extensive customization into one seamless experience.

Discover and install apps from your repositories, run multiple apps at the same time, customize your workspace, and switch between apps just like you’re used to on iOS.

Built on LiveContainer and reimagined from the ground up, FlekDeck also includes dozens of compatibility and stability improvements for hundreds of apps.

[FlekDeck repo](https://github.com/flekstore/FlekDeck/)
[LiveContainer repo](https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer)

apps.name: Fortnite
apps.subtitle: Create, play, and battle with friends in Battle Royale mode
apps.localizedDescription:
Important!
Fortnite supports iPhone 11 or later with at least 4GB of RAM.Required iOS 17.4+Fortnite requires special rights for the certificate. If you use enterpise certificate, Fortnite won't work! Fortnite requires an additional 13 GB to download. Establish a stable internet connection and do not close the app. The loading percentage may roll back, but it will grow in the future.

Explore large, destructible environments where no two games are ever the same. Team up with friends by sprinting, climbing and smashing your way to earn your Victory Royale, whether you choose to build up in Fortnite Battle Royale or go no-builds in Fortnite Zero Build.

Discover even more ways to play across thousands of creator-made game genres: adventure, roleplay, survival and more. Or, band together with up to three friends to fend off hordes of monsters in Save the World.

apps.name: Eevee Spotify
apps.subtitle: Many futures from Premium subscription
apps.localizedDescription:
Unable to Play Songs

If all tracks are skipped, a song stops as soon as you play it, songs play in a random order, you see the "You discovered a Premium feature" popup when trying to play a song, or encounter other restrictions,
You can only use Spotify abroad for 14 days. Connect to a VPN server in any country, change your region at [accounts.spotify.com](accounts.spotify.com), then sign out and log back into Spotify with the VPN enabled.

This tweak makes Spotify think you have a Premium subscription, granting free listening, just like Spotilife, and provides some additional features like custom lyrics.

This futures from premium didn't exist:
Very High audio qualityNative playlist downloading (you can download podcast episodes though)Jam (hosting a Spotify Jam and joining it remotely requires Premium; only joining in-person works)

apps.name: uYou for YouTube
apps.subtitle: Remove Ads • Backgrounds playback • Download Videos etc.
apps.localizedDescription:
With uYou, you can enjoy video and audio downloads with importing features, play videos in PiP (Picture In Picture), background audio playback, and a whole lot of other features that are usually restricted/not available in the YouTube app.

Features:
• Remove YouTube Ads.
• Background playback for YT videos.
• Download Videos/Audio/Shorts for offline playback (supports up to 4K).
• Support all YT Formats (MP4 + WebM), all qualities (from 144p to 4K) and all frames (30fps, 50fps, and 60fps).
• Play saved media in a custom player with background playback support.
• Supports mini-player for easier navigation.
• Supports scrubbing/controls from Control Center.
• Share/Export saved videos to Camera Roll or to any other app.
• Gestures Controls on Video (Swipe Left/Right to increase/decrease Volume/Brightness/Seek).
• Playback Speed Controls.
• Play videos in PiP (Picture In Picture).
• iPad layout style.
• Sideloaded iPA.
• In-app Settings.
• Support Cercube and DLEasy migration to move all of your downloads into uYou with a tap of a button.
• More options are in the settings.

apps.name: Instagram Rocket
apps.subtitle: • Anonymous Viewer • Download posts/reels/stories
apps.localizedDescription:
Download and repost Instagram media, browse Stories and DMs privately, hide ads, customize the app, and record calls—all inside Instagram.

- Download Feed media, Reels, profile videos, Stories, Instants, and supported DM visual messages.

- Manage account-specific downloads with previews, filters, sharing, retries, and bulk deletion.

- Repost Feed posts and Reels, copy captions, comments, and media links, and open media full-screen.

- Browse Stories and DMs privately with control over seen, playback, typing, and screenshot behavior.

- Hide sponsored posts, Reels, and Stories.

- Switch the home feed between List and Grid layouts.

- Watch Reels in Picture in Picture.

- Prevent doomscrolling by disabling infinite scrolling Reels.

- Make web addresses clickable.

- Customize Feed layouts, Reels auto-scroll, like confirmations, dates, and the tab bar.

- See follow-back status, enlarge profile pictures, and locally customize your profile stats.

- Record Instagram voice calls as audio and video calls with participant video and call audio.

apps.name: OldOS
apps.subtitle: Showcasing what iOS once was ten years ago.
apps.localizedDescription:
OldOS is a testament to the days of yesteryear, showcasing what iOS once was ten years ago. The ethos of the app is to merge the technologies of today with a pixel-perfect recreation of the user experience of the past. The vast majority of apps in OldOS are fully functional — meaning they seamlessly integrate with the data on your phone to deliver a live, emulator-esque experience. What does this mean? Well, you can play your music in iPod, get directions in Maps, surf the web in Safari, view the current weather in Weather, and much more. By the same token, no shortcuts were taken in fully fleshing out the operating system. You can change your background, adjust settings, search apps, et cetera. There are a few apps still not ready for primetime but don't worry, they're coming soon.

With OldOS, you no longer need to worry about securing a legacy iPhone to experience nostalgia — it's available on your daily driver.

apps.name: Focos Pro
apps.subtitle: Premium features unlocked
apps.localizedDescription:
Premium features unlocked

Focos is a big step into the future of computational photography and light-field camera, bringing DSLR-like photography to your iPhone and iPad Pro, with beautiful bokeh effects usually achievable only with professional large aperture cameras. With the technology of computational photography, you can make unlimited changes to your photos, focus after the fact, change the aperture repeatedly, and add multiple lights in 3D space, exceeding the limits of any editing tools you’ve known before. The creative potential unleashed by Focos is endless.

MAIN FEATURES

- Take photos with shallow depth of field, without manually painting or making selections.

- True 3D imaging.

- Simulate large apertures to create real bokeh effects normally only possible with DSLR cameras and expensive lenses.

- Import all existing photos and customize the bokeh effect.

- With the advanced technology of machine learning, it calculates the depth of field automatically for every photo.

- Re-focus portrait photos that have already been taken, with a simple tap.

- Choose from various simulated aperture diaphragms to generate different bokeh spot effects.

- Professional options to simulate lens characteristics, such as creamy, bilinear, swirly, and reflex effects, and more.

- Visualize the depth of areas within your portrait photos in a 3D view, and intuitively add depth filters.

- Add multiple lights in a 3D space, and adjust the color, brightness and so on for each light.

- Check the portrait picture in the real world with augmented reality technique.

- It is possible to patch the depth map precisely on iPad with Apple Pencil.

- Intuitive and easy to use, with built-in video tutorials.

- An essential tool for all iPhones and iPads.

apps.name: Perfect Video Editor, Collage
apps.subtitle: Green Screen • Movie Maker
apps.localizedDescription:
In-app purchases are open.

    Perfect Video is a really EASY TO USE and Full featured video/slideshow editing app. It lets you quickly Trim, Merge, Split, Reverse, Rotate, Mirror, Flip and Crop clips, add Subtitles, add Mosaic, add Watermark, Photos, and Text, pick Transitions, add Music and Recordings, and export your video clips.

PREMIUM FEATURES
• Keyframe animations: Various editing operations can add key points.
• Picture in Picture Video.
• Split Screen: Playing two videos side-by-side.
• Chroma Key (Green/Blue Screen): Replace the video solid background with a video or photo.
• Mosaic Video: Pixelate or blur or Highlighted a part in the video.
• Video Color: Adjust the video color (Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, Hue,…) in a real-time manner.
• Photo Motion: Set Ken Burns effect for photos.

OHTER FEATURES & HOW TO USE

• Importing Videos or Photos: Add multiple videos or photos to a project instantly.
• Multiple canvas ratios: Video original size, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 19.5:9, 9:19.5, 3:2, 2:3, 2:1, 1:2, 2.39:1 .
• Canvas background setting: Set the color or make background blur, or add a custom picture.
• Combine: Merge multiple videos, photos or text into one video clip.
• Split: With this feature, you can remove the middle part of the video,  speed up/down part of the video.
• Video to picture: Extract still images from video via Split feature.
• Trim: Cut out any unwanted moments.
• Slow Motion: Slow down or speed up video (0.25x-6x).
• Crop & Mirror & Flip & Rotate and Angle adjustment .
• Reverse: Reverse video playback.
• Duplicate: Duplicate projects or create duplicates of video clips.
• Animated Subtitles: Add animated text or images to videos.
• Watermark: Display your own logo on video.
• Volume: Mute the video or increase the video volume (0-500%).
• Music: Add multiple songs to a project. You can also choose a specific part of a song to include in your project by trimming it.
• Sound Effects: Choose from many pre-defined sound effects.
• Transitions: Select from a host of pre-defined video clip transitions.
• Video Fade In/Out: Configure the fade-in and fade-out options in the Settings screen for the first and last shots.
• Compress Video: Reduce video file size dramatically without reducing video resolution.
• Save Storage Space: Perfect Video only saves the video location so imported videos don’t take up valuable storage space (just DON'T DELETE the original video you're editing).
• High Resolution: Support for several formats, including 1920x1080HD, and support for up to 4K resolution on iPhone 6s, iPhone 6s Plus, iPad Air 2, iPad Pro and later.
• Share: Save your video to your Camera Roll or share it on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube or via email.
• Instant Actions: All actions are performed in an instant manner. No need to wait any more!

apps.name: Nestopia
apps.subtitle: Emulates the hardware in a Nintendo
apps.localizedDescription:
Nestopia is an open source emulator core that emulates the hardware in a Nintendo entertainment system, allowing you to play game images on many different platforms. Nestopia for iOS is a port of the popular core to allow you to play NES games on your iPhone or iPod Touch.Features:
- Multitouch: Use the directional pad + A + B, or other combinations
- Light Gun (Zapper): Integrated light gun; simply tap on the screen
- Full Screen: Enlarge your NES picture to the max possible. Anti-aliasing effects are also supported to smooth edges.
- Save State: Save an instant snapshot of your game and come back to it later
- Game Genie: Use Game Genie cheat codes
- Landscape and Portrait Modes: Just tilt the iPhone before you start a game
- and many more

apps.name: Adobe Scan
apps.subtitle: Scan and edit any documents. To unlock premium buy and cancel
apps.localizedDescription:
To unlock premium buy and cancel subscription in settings.

Adobe Scan is free to download and turns your mobile device into a powerful scanner that recognizes text automatically (OCR) and allows you to create, save, and organize your paper documents as a digital file.

Scan anything — receipts, notes, ID cards, recipes, photos, business cards, whiteboards — and turn them into PDF or JPEG files you can work with on your smartphone, tablet, or computer.

HOW IT WORKS
• Scan any document and convert to PDF or photo.
• Get perfect scans of book and magazine pages with Straighten in Book Mode.
• Quickly scan and save your important documents to Dropbox or Google Drive so you can access and share them wherever you are.
• Adjust the brightness and contrast of your scans in just a few taps.

CAPTURE
• Scan anything with precision with this mobile PDF scanner.
• Advanced image technology automatically detects borders, sharpens scanned content, and recognizes text (OCR).

ENHANCE
• NEW: Edit in Scan feature allows you to edit your scans.
• Preview, reorder, crop, rotate, resize, and adjust color in PDF or photo scans.
• Remove and edit imperfections, erase stains, marks, creases, even handwriting.

apps.name: Pokemon: Echoes of Time
apps.subtitle: Train over 800 distinct Pokemon and evolve them to challenge other trainers
apps.localizedDescription:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure in Pokeland Legends, a Pokémon RPG featuring over 800 distinct Pokémon. Choose your favorites, train them, and evolve together as you challenge other trainers for fame and glory.
Collect Over 800 Unique Pokémon
Explore a vast world filled with more than 800 different Pokémon, each with their own unique abilities and skills. Level up your Pokémon through training, improving their skills and attributes to make them stronger and more adaptable in battle.
Engage in Strategic Turn-Based Combat
Pokeland Legends offers a turn-based combat system that requires strategic planning based on your Pokémon's abilities and strengths. Take part in story-driven quests and competitive arenas to earn rewards and prove your skills as a trainer.
Explore a Massive World
Dive into a large, diverse world brimming with secrets and adventure. Complete captivating story quests and take on tough missions to uncover the mysteries hidden within Pokeland.
Build and Empower Your Pokémon Team
Form a strong team of Pokémon and tackle increasingly difficult challenges. Strengthen your team’s synergy and abilities to rise through the ranks and claim victory in battles.
Experience the ultimate Pokémon adventure in Pokémon: Echoes of Time, where every trainer's dream becomes a reality. Start your journey today and become the ultimate Pokémon Master!

apps.name: NesEmu
apps.subtitle: NES emulator
apps.localizedDescription:
NES/Famicom emulator based on FCEUX-2.1.5-svn. Significantly more accurate than other NES emulators for iOS especially with regards to audio quality. Requires iOS 3.1+ and natively supports iPad and iPhone 5 displays. Tested running 60fps on the iPhone 4/4S (3GS or newer recommended).

Features include:
* Backup memory and save state support, auto-save and ten manual slots for save states. State files from FCEUX should work on NES.emu and vice-versa.
* Supports ROM-based games in .nes and .unf formats, optionally in .zip files
* Famicom Disk System emulation using .fds files (select your BIOS in the options first)
* VS UniSystem support, push Start to insert coins
* Zapper/Gun support, touch screen to fire, touch & hold outside of display area to simulate firing away from the TV
* Configurable on-screen multi-touch controls
* iCade, Wiimote + Classic Controller, Wii U Pro Controller, PS3 Controller, iControlPad, and Zeemote support

apps.subtitle: Safari extension to view source code
apps.localizedDescription:
Price in the AppStore $0.99

Source is an app plus a Safari extension that makes it easy to do one key web developer task: view the HTML source of any web page, with beautiful and customisable syntax highlighting.

Just browse the web in Safari as you normally would, and if you want to view the source for your current page just tap the Action icon and choose Source.

The following steps show you how to get extensions to enhance your browsing experience in Safari on ‌iOS 15‌.

Settings app → Safari → Extensions → toggle on the app or settings.

apps.name: Reigns+
apps.subtitle: $2.99 in AppStore.
apps.localizedDescription:
Price in Appstore $2.99

Sit on the throne as a benevolent (or malevolent) medieval monarch of the modern age and swipe your royal fingers either left or right to impose your will upon the kingdom. Survive the seemingly never-ending gauntlet of requests from your advisors, peasants, allies, and enemies while maintaining balance between the influential factions of your kingdom. But beware; each decision you make might have implications and unfortunate consequences down the road that could put your reign and family’s dynasty at risk!

Each year of your reign brings another important – seemingly random – request from your unpredictable kingdom as you strive for balance between the church, the people, the army, and the treasury. Prudent decisions and careful planning make for a long reign but unforeseen motivations, surprise events, and poor luck can take down even the most entrenched monarch. Extend your reign as long as possible, forge alliances, make enemies, and find new ways to die as your dynasty marches along through the ages. Some events will span on centuries, with an intrigue involving burning witches, scientific enlightenment, wicked politics and, maybe, the Devil himself.

*iPhone 5 / iPod Touch 6 / iPad Mini / iPad Air or later recommended.

Extend your reign as long as possible, forge alliances, make enemies, and find new ways to die as your dynasty marches along through the ages. Some events will span on centuries, with an intrigue involving burning witches, scientific enlightenment, wicked politics and, maybe, the Devil himself.

apps.name: CleanMyPhone: Storage Cleaner
apps.subtitle: Subscription unlocked
apps.localizedDescription:
What can CleanMyPhone cleaner do?

CLEAN UP YOUR IPHONE STORAGE
If you love snapping photos, it’s easy to clog up your phone with blurred images, old screenshots, large videos, and multiple pictures of the same thing. CleanMyPhone will scan your entire library for photo clutter and optimize your storage.

DELETE DUPLICATES AND SIMILAR PHOTOS
We all end up with too many photos in an attempt to get the perfect shot. But do we need all those identical images? CleanMyPhone looks for photo duplicates and similar shots, helping you pick the best picture and remove not-so-good copies.

COMPRESS VIDEOS
CleanMyPhone lets you compress any video with minimal loss of quality. Free up space instantly and keep more of what you love on your iPhone.

TURN LIVE PHOTOS TO STILL IMAGES
How many Live Photos do you have? Our cleaner app helps you convert Live Photos to still images to free up some space for new ones.

apps.subtitle: $4.99 on App Store
apps.localizedDescription:
Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted physics platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 4 players. Free new levels keep its vibrant community rewarded. Each dream level provides a new environment to navigate, from mansions, castles and Aztec adventures to snowy mountains, eerie nightscapes and industrial locations. Multiple routes through each level, and perfectly playful puzzles ensure exploration and ingenuity are rewarded.

MORE HUMANS, MORE MAYHEM - Need a hand getting that boulder on to a catapult, or need someone to break that wall? Online multiplayer for up to 4 players transforms the way Human Fall Flat is played.

MIND BENDING PUZZLES - Explore open-ended levels full of challenging puzzles and hilarious distractions. Try new paths and discover all the secrets!

A BLANK CANVAS - Your Human is yours to customize. With outfits from builder to chef, skydiver, miner, astronaut and ninja. Choose your head, upper and lower body and get creative with the colors!

FREE GREAT CONTENT - Since launch more than four brand new levels have launched free of charge with even more on the horizon. What could the next dreamscape have in store?

apps.name: Leo's Fortune+
apps.subtitle: Adventure game where you hunt down mysterious thief that stole your gold
apps.localizedDescription:
App Store Best of 2014 and 2014 WWDC Apple Design Award winner!

Leo’s Fortune is a platform adventure game where you hunt down the cunning and mysterious thief that stole your gold. Beautifully hand-crafted levels bring the story of Leo to life in this epic adventure.

“Virtually flawless…could be called the best game on the platform” – 5 out of 5 Apple’N’Apps

“Every level is meticulously detailed...Every scene looks simply spectacular” 5 out of 5 stars – Toucharcade

“One of the most beautiful iOS games I’ve seen in a while…It will make you smile the instant you pick it up” 5 out of 5 stars Cult of Mac

“I just returned home to find all my gold has been stolen! For some devious purpose, the thief has dropped pieces of my gold like breadcrumbs through the woods. Despite this pickle of a trap, I am left with no choice but to follow the trail. Whatever lies ahead, I must recover my fortune.” -Leopold

VOYAGE through lush environments from mossy forests and arid deserts, to pirate cities and snowy mountains.

SURVIVE vicious traps and solve physics-based puzzles through 24 levels of treacherous adventure.

FOLLOW the trail of gold and uncover the truth behind Leo’s stolen fortune.

Finish Leo’s Fortune to unlock Hard-core Mode: try to beat the whole game without dying to unlock a special prize! Compete with your Game Center friends to beat as many levels as you can in the fastest time possible.

Leo’s Fortune supports iCloud game saves and Game Controllers made for iPhone, iPad, and iPod Touch. Game Controller support requires iOS 7 or later and is compatible with iPhone 5, iPhone 5s, iPhone 5c, iPad 2 or later, and iPod touch (5th generation).*

An internet connection prior to the start of level 7 will be necessary to complete the download of app data for Leo’s Fortune.

Playing as a child whose role is yet unknown, you must safeguard yourself until 6am by watching the doors, as well as warding off unwanted creatures that may venture into your closet or onto the bed behind you.
You have only a flashlight to protect yourself. It will scare away things that may be creeping at the far end of the hallways, but be careful, and listen. If something has crept too close, then shining lights in its eyes will be your end.

apps.name: Dehancer
apps.subtitle: Premium features unlocked
apps.localizedDescription:
Elevate your photos and videos with our analog tools for a film-like aesthetic:

• Film Profiles: Choose from 60+ accurate film profiles, including classics like Kodak Vision, Kodak Portra 400, Cinestill 800T, and more. Explore vintage options like Ambrotype.
• Presets: Instantly recreate retro film vibes with handcrafted presets. Craft your own and share them effortlessly.
• Film Grain: Our unique algorithm creates customizable film-like grain, adding authenticity to your visuals.
• Print Tools: Combine films with print profiles for authentic analog images. Customize characteristics like contrast and photo latitude.
• Film Compression: Adjust highlights to mimic the compressed tonal range of film. Emulate the analog appearance and have editing flexibility.
• Halation: Reproduce the film's red-orange halo effect around light sources and edges, enhancing the appeal and natural tones.
• Bloom: Add warmth and vintage glow resembling optical filters. Dehancer accurately replicates the real physics of light and simulates the Bloom effect in the most analogous way.
• Vignette: Add depth and focus using vignetting.
• Film Breath & Gate Weave: Dynamic animated effects for video, simulating real film-like shifts between frames.

apps.name: Electronics Toolkit Hack
apps.subtitle: Helpfull calculators, tables for electronic engineers
apps.localizedDescription:
Hack version.
Electronics Toolkit is a helpful app with dozens of tools, calculators and references made for electronic engineers, students and hobbyists.

Calculators:
• Resistor color codes - calculate the resistance of resistors by selecting the colors of the bands
• SMD resistor codes - calculate the resistance of SMD resistors by entering the number
• LED resistor calculator - calculate the needed resistance to connect en LED to a power source
• Parallel resistors - calculate the resistance of resistors in parallel
• Voltage divider - calculate the output voltage of a voltage divider
• Series resistors - calculate the resistance of resistors in series
• Ohm's law - calculate the voltage, current of resistance by entering the other two
etc.

apps.subtitle: Hacked version of ABBYY Lingvo Dictionary.
apps.localizedDescription:
Hacked version of ABBYY Lingvo Dictionary.

ABBYY Lingvo Dictionary quickly and accurately translates words and phrases without an Internet connection.

Key Features:

• Photo-translation - translation of words from the smartphone’s built-in camera or from images in your phone (not supported for Chinese and Kazakh).

• Flashcards for effective learning of words (with synchronization of flashcards between devices).

• Convenient work with several dictionaries at the same time: a general words list, a combined dictionary card.

• Dictionary entry contains detailed information about words, including translation alternatives, word usage examples, phonetic transcriptions, inflected forms of words and native audio pronunciation (in some dictionaries).

• A quick translation directly from the clipboard. 

• Hypertext - instant translation of any word found in the dictionary entries with just a single tap.

• Spelling suggestions for mistyped words.

• The ability to use purchased dictionaries on another device (with the same Apple Id).

apps.name: Dead Cells+
apps.subtitle: Roguelike-Metroidvania
apps.localizedDescription:
Play as a failed alchemic experiment and explore the sprawling, ever-changing castle to find out what happened on this gloomy island…! That is, assuming you’re able to fight your way past its keepers.
Dead Cells+ is a roguevania action platformer that will require you to master frantic 2D combat with a wide variety of weapons and skills against merciless minions and boss.
The indie hit Dead Cells+ is now slaying foes on Apple Arcade!

Main Features
• Roguevania: The progressive exploration of an interconnected world, with the replayability of a rogue-lite and the adrenaline pumping threat of permadeath
• Frantic and Dynamic 2D Action: Learn your enemies’ patterns to stay alive, or prepare to be sent back to your cell before you can say “baguette”
• Nonlinear Progression: Unlock new levels with every death, opt for the path that suits your current build, your playstyle or just your mood.
Surely, the ramparts can’t be as bad the sewers, right?
• Play at your own pace: Will you explore every nook and cranny of the castle, or rush to the end?

Dead Cells+ is a roguevania action platformer that will require you to master frantic 2D combat with a wide variety of weapons and skills against merciless minions and boss.
The indie hit Dead Cells+ is now slaying foes on Apple Arcade!

Main Features
• Roguevania: The progressive exploration of an interconnected world, with the replayability of a rogue-lite and the adrenaline pumping threat of permadeath
• Frantic and Dynamic 2D Action: Learn your enemies’ patterns to stay alive, or prepare to be sent back to your cell before you can say “baguette”
• Nonlinear Progression: Unlock new levels with every death, opt for the path that suits your current build, your playstyle or just your mood.
Surely, the ramparts can’t be as bad the sewers, right?
• Play at your own pace: Will you explore every nook and cranny of the castle, or rush to the end?

apps.name: Heads Up!
apps.subtitle: $1.99 in AppStore
apps.localizedDescription:
Price in AppStore $1.99

Love playing charades games? Heads Up! is just that, a fun twist on charades! From naming celebrities, to singing, to silly accents - guess the word on the card that’s on your head from your friends’ clues before the timer runs out!

Play one of the many exciting categories, including fun game decks like Harry Potter, Friends, and Marvel, or create a category all your own!

How to play Heads Up:

Pick a card deck category - check! One player holds the phone to their glorious forehead like a headband, and 3, 2, 1! Go! Guess the words on the screen as your friends excitedly shout out clues. Got an answer right? Ding! Tilt your head down and keep on ruling this guessing game, you genius! Can’t guess what it is? Don’t stress! Just tilt your head up and skip to a new catch phrase. So get your head on straight, and enjoy one of the best party games!

apps.name: SummaryAI - AI Note Taker
apps.subtitle: Premium features unlocked
apps.localizedDescription:
Premium features unlocked

Summary AI is a tool that uses AI to streamline meeting notes and transcriptions. It records audio and creates precise transcripts with speaker labels. It also organizes content into formatted notes and summaries, allowing users to search for key terms or topics. Users can ask questions like, "What were the main action items discussed during the marketing strategy session?". The platform prioritizes privacy, ensuring notes are secure and never shared with third parties.

Summary AI is useful for:
- Taking meeting notes and sharing them with colleagues.
- Recording and transcribing interviews, lectures, podcasts, videos, webinars, and more.
- Providing captions for individuals with hearing impairments or those using quiet microphones.

Features include:
- One-click live recording and transcription.
- Accurate transcriptions with speaker identification.
- A summarized list of key points for review.
- AI tools to ask questions and interact with the recording.

Additional functionality:
- Automatic punctuation, capitalization, and line breaks.
- Find Keyword & Go to timestamp.
- Editing tools for correcting transcription errors.
